verdict.rationale: Weaviate documents natural-language querying through the Query Agent and quickstart prompts ('Get answers from your data by using a natural language prompt/question'), but these are marked Cloud only. An official MCP server also lets LLMs and IDE assistants interact with an instance, which gives an indirect route to natural-language operation. Missing for 10: natural-language control of operational tasks (collection setup, tenants, backups) beyond search, natural-language support on self-hosted deployments, documentation of what the MCP server can actually do, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
